title: Contains duplicate
statement:
Given an integer array nums, return true if any value appears at least twice, and false if every element is distinct.

Constraints: up to 2 × 10⁴ elements (larger in follow-ups); values fit in 32 bits.
hints: What do you need to remember about the elements you've already seen?
A hash set answers "seen before?" in O(1) on average.
complexity: O(n) time, O(n) space (or O(n log n) time, O(1) extra by sorting)

solution.explanation: Keep a hash set of values seen so far; the first value already in it is a duplicate. O(n) expected time and O(n) space. Sorting and comparing neighbours trades the space for O(n log n) time; say both in an interview and pick by the constraints.
